builds with its own ThreadPool; publishes the new
BuiltIndex, then shuts the pool down.
or "index has not been built yet".
One request per connection (Session.busy); the request
runs on the pool so the WebSocket thread can reject
further messages. inFlight is capped at workers + queue
(24), so submit() never blocks ("server busy" beyond).
Sends under Session.sendLock; the busy flag is cleared
